name: Miraj Note: Sticky Notes, Notepad & Note Taking Extension
description: A fast Chrome notepad and sticky notes extension. Take quick notes, clip web text, use voice typing, and auto-sync with Google Drive

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src https://www.googleapis.com https://oauth2.googleapis.com;
